description: A night scene inside a richly hung tent pavilion with patterned red and gold textiles. An elderly bearded man in a white turban and fur-trimmed embroidered robe sits on a red cushioned throne. Two men in dark doublets kneel on a rug in the foreground, one holding a paper and gesturing toward him. Attendants in dark robes and mail stand around, torches and oil lamps light the scene, and trees and another tent are visible through the open side. No text, no frame.
